panelIntro: Training happens on this device, in this browser. Your photos are not sent anywhere to do it.
cancelled: Training stopped. Your photos are all still here.
done: Trained. Try it out on the right.

refuse.needTwoClasses: You need at least two classes before you can train. The computer learns to tell things apart, so it needs at least two things.
refuse.emptyClass: The class "{{name}}" has no photos yet. Take a few, or delete the class, and then train.
refuse.emptyClasses: These classes have no photos yet: {{names}}. Take a few for each, or delete them, and then train.
refuse.fewSamples: You only have {{count}} photos in "{{name}}". It will train, but it will guess better with more — try ten or so.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.intro: The defaults work well. Changing them is a good way to see what they do.

epochs.label: Rounds of practice
epochs.help: How many times the computer goes over your photos. More rounds usually means a better fit to the photos you gave it — and, past a point, worse at anything else.

batchSize.label: Photos per step
batchSize.help: How many photos it looks at before adjusting. Smaller steps are slower but often steadier.

backbone.label: Detail level
backbone.help: The bigger option looks at more detail and usually does better; the smaller one is faster on an older phone.
backbone.changeWarning: Changing this means every photo has to be looked at again. Nothing is lost — it just takes a moment.

recompute.heading: Getting your photos ready
recompute.body: The detail level changed, so each photo is being looked at again. Your photos are safe.

interrupted.heading: A training run did not finish
interrupted.body: Training "{{name}}" was interrupted — the tab probably closed. An unfinished model is not used for guessing, because it would look confident and be wrong. Train again when you are ready.

backendWarning: This device has no graphics acceleration, so training and heat maps will take longer. Everything still works.
